proposals.before: Since Kangxi 53 (1714), when the native official Lu Dingqian broke the law, imperial commissioners and the provincial governors jointly tried Bi Jie; Lu emerged only after a regular official was sent in as hostage—and from then on he grew ever bolder.
proposals.after: Since Kangxi 53 (1714), when the native official Lu Dingqian broke the law, imperial commissioners and the provincial governors held a joint trial at Bijie; Lu emerged only after a regular official was sent in as hostage—and from then on he grew ever bolder.
proposals.reason: Chinese 會審畢節 means the joint trial was held at the place Bijie, not that a person named Bi Jie was tried.

decisions.reason: The grammar places 畢節 after 會審 as the location of the joint trial. Bijie is a place, not the person being tried; the offender named in the sentence is Lu Dingqian.
